sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r10/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 30 and Internal Quality Checks row 30, read via openpyxl read_only)
evidence: Design review of every negative/refusal/absence leg in the frozen gates and scored judges (no weak-app judge run exists). Shared rule: functional prompt.md:13 'Every refusal row needs its own positive control: a successful action of the same kind, observed in this review.'; prompt.md:17 role replays must be legal requests with 'the same fresh request as Rafael afterwards ... as its control' and a 'changed/out of date' refusal does not count as the rule's refusal; prompt.md:13 gate (job+candidate created and read back in an independent Observer context) zeroes every binary row for a blank/static shell; every criterion ends 'Fails if any condition stated above does not hold', so a control stated as successful is a condition. Per-row pairing in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml: hro_job_open (l.84 refusals; 'the successful opening is the control'; 'Fails if ... a valid one is not'); hro_add_email_rules (l.102 'same address on a different job is accepted (the control)'); hro_move_one_stage (l.111 'Fails if ... a one-stage move is refused'); hro_reject_reason (l.138 blank refused vs reason accepted with readable stage/reason); hro_reject_hired (l.147 'A rejection of a non-hired card is the control'); hro_reopen (l.156 elsewhere refused vs 'cannot be reopened to its own' fails); hro_interview_full (l.165 'the two cards that entered Interview are the control'); hro_undo_full (l.183 'the same undo goes ahead ... (the same-kind control)'); hro_mgr_early_refused (l.210 'their late-stage moves are the control'); hro_mgr_other_job (l.219 own manager's move); hro_observer_readonly (l.228 'Rafael's identical successful requests are the control'); hro_candidate_no_staff (l.237 explicit 0 if no own data and 'or the staff control did not succeed'); hro_anonymous (l.246 'A signed-in success of each is the control', plus exact 401 per hireops_rules.md:21); hro_stale_refused (l.255 original move control plus positive 'identifies who'); hro_bulk_all_or_none (l.273 successful multi-card moves control); hro_bulk_places (l.282 'Fails if ... the fitting set is refused'); hro_undo_conflict (l.300 'undo after an unrelated change is refused' fails); hro_undo_once (l.309 successful undos control); hro_activity_refusals (l.327 'The successful actions' lines are the control'); hro_notes (l.336 permitted notes must succeed); hro_msg_compose (l.363 'A normal send is the control'); hro_unread_counts (l.390 no-rise-while-open paired with rise by exactly two); hro_unread_scrolled_up (l.399 no jump paired with notice within 15s); hro_seen (l.408 not-seen after Observer paired with seen after Tomas/Bill/Rafael); hro_thread_access (l.417 Rafael/Mei/Bill writes, 'Rafael's own send is the control'); hro_candidate_private (l.444 own data control, Rafael's identical read succeeded, 'A candidate page that receives none of its own data is 0'); hro_restart (l.462 not loaded again paired with seeded order/note and new data present). Gates: gates/render/judge.toml l.24 incorrect password refused paired with correct-password sign-in to populated workspace (prompt.md l.13 'A valid sign-in immediately after the invalid attempt is the required positive control'); gates/constraints positive-only. Polish judge.toml: hro_pol_live_board l.43 and hro_pol_live_thread l.52 'If no update arrives within 15 seconds ... this row is 0'; hro_pol_failed_send l.70 not-sent paired with 'send again: it is sent once'; hro_pol_session_resume l.79 'nothing was sent' paired with resend 'which is the positive control', and Mei-sees-empty paired with Rafael's drafts still there. Visual rows are likert craft with no absence legs. Broken-app probes: (a) app whose managers can do nothing earns no hro_mgr_early_refused/hro_mgr_other_job because the late-stage/own-manager moves are stated controls; (b) app with no Activity at all fails hro_activity_refusals via its control; (c) app without multi-card move cannot earn hro_bulk_all_or_none/hro_bulk_places (controls and 'fitting set is refused'); (d) app where nothing sends fails hro_msg_compose/hro_thread_access/hro_pol_failed_send; (e) a dead live-update channel fails polish preservation rows by the explicit 0 clause. Conforming-alternative probe: hiding refused controls is allowed (replay rule prompt.md:23, 'hiding it is optional'), so a conforming app is not penalised for not offering a refused action. Minor note (P3, not a defect): hro_mgr_early_refused names the manager's late-stage moves as control while its open-job/add-candidate/Applied-reorder legs get their same-kind control only from prompt.md:17 (Rafael's identical fresh request); the shared rule covers it. Risk remains true because enforcement of controls is measured nowhere: raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'; its six artifacts' hashes and matching_source_files were re-verified against current bytes and the frozen task (all match), but they are scripted golden observations only, with no weak/broken-app run under the configured judge showing that a dead feature earns 0 on these refusal rows.
